introduction: Welcome to the study of The Living Organisms — Characteristics and Habitats. In this chapter, we explore essential concepts and their applications in the world around us.
revisionNotes: Habitats can be terrestrial (land) or aquatic (water). Living things grow, breathe, respond to stimuli, and reproduce. Adaptation is key to survival.
keyTakeaways: Core concepts of The Living Organisms — Characteristics and Habitats
